groups.topic: Mars body: misfortunes, military power and judicial qualifier

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Medium Caeli to the Body of Mars
claims.historical_meaning_only: A separate conjunction section, not the term or aspects of Mars.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: greatest mischances both of Life and Fortunes
claims.historical_meaning_only: The author alleges dramatic high-stakes misfortune; historical only.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: not knowing from whom
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged lack of awareness of opposing cause is a qualification.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: wrath of powerfull men especially Martialists
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged hostility from martial or powerful figures.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: banishment imprisonment hatred
claims.historical_meaning_only: Period legal and social threats, not facts about anyone.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: consumption of Patrimony by fire theft
claims.historical_meaning_only: Fire and theft are described as economic loss mechanisms.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: In a Kings or Princes Nativity ... warre
claims.historical_meaning_only: Royal warfare allegation conditional on elite chart/social rank.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: wrong their Subjects ... proudly and insolently
claims.historical_meaning_only: Moralized accusations toward monarchs, source stereotype.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: effusion of much blood
claims.historical_meaning_only: Period violent claim, not predictive evidence.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To Souldiers ... Military command
claims.historical_meaning_only: The same configuration allegedly offers military command for soldiers.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: where a violent death is designed ... Magistrate
claims.historical_meaning_only: Death timing claim depends explicitly on another natal indication; cannot infer injury/death.

groups.topic: Mars sextile or trine: combat skills, trade, class conditions

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the sextile or trine of Mars
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source distinguishes favorable aspects from Mars conjunction/adverse.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: use of Armes Fencing Shooting
claims.historical_meaning_only: An alleged inclination to arms practices.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: accompany Souldiers
claims.historical_meaning_only: Social company with military men, not equal to combat.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: delight in riding hunting
claims.historical_meaning_only: Hobbies/recreation targets separate from soldier role.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: respected of Commanders
claims.historical_meaning_only: Respect from military leaders is alleged.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if himself is capable ... preferment by War
claims.historical_meaning_only: War promotion explicitly conditional on personal capacity.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: In Tradesmen ... quicke Trading
claims.historical_meaning_only: Claims commercial activity for merchants; not universal war success.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: sharpens the invention
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleges ingenuity independent of earnings.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To Kings ... begin War ... provide Amunition
claims.historical_meaning_only: Monarch war preparations are conditional on rank.

groups.topic: Mars square or opposition: legal, military and class-dependent threats

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the square or opposition of Mars
claims.historical_meaning_only: Adverse aspect differs from Mars sextile/trine.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: many evils robberies contentions quarrels
claims.historical_meaning_only: Historical general threats stated as an adverse group.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: restraint of liberty
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged confinement is a separate source category.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: from himselfe as from others
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source explicitly allows self-caused and externally caused harm.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: many times publique Death is threatened
claims.historical_meaning_only: Period mortality assertion must not be used for human forecasts.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: publique accusations
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged accusations distinct from actual conviction.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Coyning or counterfeiting Monies
claims.historical_meaning_only: Accusation category singled out historically, not an actual allegation.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: losse of Offices Commands
claims.historical_meaning_only: Loss of authority/honors separate from loss of wealth.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: in Kings or Princes danger of Deposing
claims.historical_meaning_only: Deposition claim conditional on royalty.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: losse of their Armies tumults ... Mutinies
claims.historical_meaning_only: Threatened military reversals and revolts, royalty-only.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: in a time of Peace ... oppression of Kings
claims.historical_meaning_only: Historic class- and political-context distinction.

groups.topic: Mars terms: martial anger, family and trade exceptions

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the Termes of Mars
claims.historical_meaning_only: Planetary terms direction separately named.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: anger of Martiall men against him
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged anger from martial men.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: sorrow and mischiefe unto the Mother
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source claims family harm; not a death or medical inference.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: some of the Natives little Children
claims.historical_meaning_only: Additional conditional harm to young children, not an individualized claim.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: rash and unadvised actions
claims.historical_meaning_only: Period behavioral claim; not a diagnosis.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Trades-mans credit ... in question
claims.historical_meaning_only: For merchants, alleged commercial reputational trouble.

groups.topic: Sun body: honors, parental and birth-class consequences

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Medium Caeli to the Body of the Sun
claims.historical_meaning_only: New directed Sun body/conjunction source condition.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: prefers the Native to dignity and honour
claims.historical_meaning_only: Claim of formal distinction and prestige.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: well accepted of Kings Nobles
claims.historical_meaning_only: Claims favor from nobles and officials.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: fidelity and wisdome
claims.historical_meaning_only: Period personality evaluations offered as a mechanism.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: more publiquely taken notice of
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged greater public notice.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: In a Regall Nativity ... accesse to the Kingdome
claims.historical_meaning_only: Royal succession only for a regal nativity.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if the Parents be living ... prosperous unto them
claims.historical_meaning_only: Benefit to parents is explicitly conditional on their survival.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: even in vulgar Nativities ... esteem
claims.historical_meaning_only: Even low-status natal cases allegedly gain reputation.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: elevates the Native his conceptions
claims.historical_meaning_only: Claims ambitious ideas, not necessarily objective accomplishment.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: grow proud and prodigall
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source also includes adverse behavioral changes.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: sometimes kills the Mother or shewes her death
claims.historical_meaning_only: Severe maternal death claim preserved as a historical claim only.

groups.topic: Sun sextile or trine: honors, gifts, public administration

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the sextile or trine of Sun
claims.historical_meaning_only: Distinct Sun favorable aspects.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: publique Offices and honours
claims.historical_meaning_only: Claim of public office.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: gifts and friendship ... King Prince Nobleman
claims.historical_meaning_only: Patronage from elites, not general friendship.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: foundation of arising to great preferment
claims.historical_meaning_only: Progression toward further advancement is conditional/rhetorical.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: magnanimous bountifull
claims.historical_meaning_only: Moral/psychological label treated as source stereotype.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: governe the Common-wealth or part of it
claims.historical_meaning_only: Public role conditional on social capacity and system.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: In a Kings Nativity ... doe justice
claims.historical_meaning_only: Monarch-specific favorable character/governance assertion.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: progresse into many parts of his Kingdome
claims.historical_meaning_only: Claim of royal journey and popularity, status-specific.

groups.topic: Sun square/opposition: reversal, family consequences and rulers

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the square or opposition of Sun
claims.historical_meaning_only: Distinct adverse solar aspects.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: odious to great Men
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged change in relations with powerful persons.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: loose his Offices honour or preferments
claims.historical_meaning_only: Claim of sudden status loss.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: a Trades-man cracks his credit
claims.historical_meaning_only: Business credit loss is trader-specific.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or turns Bankrupt
claims.historical_meaning_only: Bankruptcy alleged as a separate adverse economic outcome.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: danger of being imprisoned banished
claims.historical_meaning_only: Historical legal threats; no actionable prediction.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if the Nativity threaten ... sentenced to death
claims.historical_meaning_only: The severest legal outcome explicitly requires another natal threat.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Where Parents living ... losse of their Estate by fire
claims.historical_meaning_only: Parent misfortune presupposes living parents.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: King ... blemishes his honour by pride
claims.historical_meaning_only: Moralized royal-rank outcome.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: scornes Nobility and Gentry ... smarts for it
claims.historical_meaning_only: Conditional elite conflict and consequences in same passage.
